requirements.text: The page shows the name Brew Lab as text.
The page shows the address 12, 100 Feet Road, Indiranagar, Bengaluru 560038 as text, so customers can view the shop name and address.
The page has no embedded map. The address is the only location information on the page.
The menu lists exactly seven items: Filter coffee 90, Cappuccino 160, Latte 180, Cold brew 200, Masala chai 80, Almond croissant 140 and Banana bread slice 120.
Every menu price is in rupees and matches the number given in R4, so customers can read the menu and prices.
The page has a pre-order form with the fields name, phone, items and pickup time, and no other fields.
When the person ordering submits the pre-order form, the order is sent to hello@brewlab.example, where the Shop team receives it.
Customers collect the order at the shop.
No online payment is taken. The page has no payment fields.
The page works on phones, with no horizontal overflow at 360px width.
The page does not show opening hours or a shop phone number.
The page is one file of plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript with no build step, and it contains the same facts as the PRD, HLD and LLD with no contradictions.

components.name: Shop identity block
components.responsibility: shows the name Brew Lab and the address 12, 100 Feet Road, Indiranagar, Bengaluru 560038 as text, with no embedded map, so the address is the only location information

components.name: Menu list
components.responsibility: shows exactly seven items with prices in rupees: Filter coffee 90, Cappuccino 160, Latte 180, Cold brew 200, Masala chai 80, Almond croissant 140 and Banana bread slice 120

components.name: Pre-order form
components.responsibility: collects the fields name, phone, items and pickup time, and no other fields

components.name: Order delivery
components.responsibility: sends the submitted pre-order to hello@brewlab.example, where the Shop team receives it

components.name: Pickup and payment notice
components.responsibility: tells the person ordering that the order is collected at the shop and that no online payment is taken, so the page has no payment fields

components.name: Phone layout
components.responsibility: arranges the page so it works on phones, with no horizontal overflow at 360px width

components.name: page content check
components.responsibility: keeps opening hours and a shop phone number off the page. The phone field in C3 belongs to the person ordering and is not a shop phone number

components.name: single package file
components.responsibility: delivers the page as one file of plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript with no build step, with the same facts as the PRD, HLD and LLD

elements.trigger: submit, when every field is valid
elements.behaviour: the page builds one order message from the four fields (name, phone, items and pickup time) and sends it to hello@brewlab.example, where the shop team receives it (implements C3, C4). The message states that the order is collected at the shop. No payment is requested. After sending, the status text area shows a short confirmation that the order was sent for pickup at the shop

elements.trigger: submit, when any field is empty or invalid under the rules in the Form fields section
elements.behaviour: the page does not send the order, shows a short message in the status text area naming each field to fix, and moves focus to the first invalid field (implements C3)

revisions.reason: E1 and E2 give selectors '#pre-order form' and 'form[id="pre-order-form"]'. The form is built as #pre-order-form inside #pre-order, so both match it, but the slice check reports neither on the page.
